signoff: Built in Bengaluru  ·  Open to collaboration

parts: Every year, a Bengaluru commuter loses about 168 hours to rush-hour traffic.
That's one full week. Standing still.
Ten kilometres takes about thirty-six minutes.
It's signals, buses, the metro, roadworks and weather, all working alone.
What if they talked to each other?
Signals that learn from the roads around them.
One live map for every bus and train.
Roadworks planned with real data, open for anyone to check.
A shared, trusted record, so everyone can believe the data.
Not one company. Not one department.
It takes engineers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
Rivers become an ocean when they meet.
Let's give Bengaluru its week back.
